results.summary:
Docs now say, per profile, what spend data it produces — and say it where a profile is chosen.

docs/harnesses.md: the page's table gained a "spend" column and the missing claude-track row, and the
claude row's "attempt cost + session id from the job" is gone — it was wrong, a background agent writes
a launch banner and no JSON. A new section, "What a profile can tell you it spent", sits between "Which
profiles a board gets" and the per-harness detail: the four bases (reported / estimate / usage /
nothing) and how each reads, a per-profile table of what an attempt leaves behind, stats.rates (which
lived only in src/stats.js and the hint line the report prints), the track case, and the reason a Claude
profile can still come back unmeasured.

README.md: the profiles section says the same in one paragraph at the point of choice. The stats
section was stale in two ways and is now correct: the sample block still had the pre-#123 wording
("$9.02 · recorded on 3 of 29 worker attempts") and no usage line, and the prose still claimed that
"harnesses whose log has no final JSON simply report no cost". The new sample was rendered through
formatStats rather than written by hand. The Actions "what you give up" list now says those attempts
are counted and never priced, and the SQLite-mapping row for hkb stats names the transcript fallback.
One unrelated one-word fix in a paragraph I was already editing: the launch is --permission-mode
dontAsk, not acceptEdits (src/board.js:30).

I read the siblings and ran hkb stats rather than paraphrasing the task body, and two things it implied
are not true today. Both are filed, and the docs describe behaviour as it is, each pointing at its issue:

  #125 (triage, p1) — hkb hook stop returns 0 unless KB_TASK is in its environment, and a claude --bg
  worker never gets it: the session runs under Claude Code's daemon, which does not inherit the env the
  dispatcher sets on the launch. Evidence: inside this live worker process.env.KB_TASK is undefined; no
  process on the host carries a KB_* variable; no worker worktree has the .kanban/nudges/ directory
  stopHook creates unconditionally once KB_TASK is set; and no attempt row on this board carries
  session_id or transcript_path (hkb stats --since all: "65 worker attempts priced nothing at all" —
  the three that do have a cost got it from their worker log, back when claude was a -p profile). So on
  the two default profiles nothing records a session: no nudge, no resume line, and nothing for #120's
  transcript pricing to read. That is #115's stated goal — spend visibility on claude-bg — still unmet
  after all three of its children landed. Worth linking #125 as a blocker of #115 rather than closing it.

  #126 (todo, p3) — since #119 every node of a track carries the runner's transcript_path, and
  priceOf/summarizeSpend work per attempt row, so one session's tokens are counted once per node.
  Reproduced against src/stats.js: three node attempts naming one 100-turn transcript report
  usage.turns 300 and three times the estimate.

No source file was touched: src/stats.js and src/hook.js were read only. Draft PR #128.
